agents.name: Set_Containment_Type
agents.description: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for containment routing. To add a new attack type, add one row to LOCAL.containment_table. Unlisted alerts default to disable_user.

agents.name: Requires_Approval
agents.description: High-impact containment (disable_user, isolate_host) needs analyst approval. block_ip goes through automatically (NO_MATCH path).

agents.name: Request_Approval
agents.description: Posts Approve/Reject links (PROMPT) to the Jira incident. Clicking a link resumes this action with prompt.status.

payload.body:
*APPROVAL REQUIRED*
Proposed containment: *<<set_containment_type.containment_type>>*
Alert: <<set_containment_type.alert_name>>
User: <<webhook.body.result.user>>

To decide, transition this ticket to *Containment Approved* or *Containment Rejected* and add a comment with your justification. If there's no decision within 4 hours, no action is taken.
Containment (<<set_containment_type.containment_type>>) REJECTED in Jira by <<LAST(get_jira_approval_status.body.changelog.histories).author.displayName>>. No automated action taken.
Containment (<<set_containment_type.containment_type>>) APPROVED in Jira by <<LAST(get_jira_approval_status.body.changelog.histories).author.displayName>>. Executing now.

agents.name: Wait_For_Approval
agents.description: Waits 60s between Jira approval status checks.

agents.name: Get_Jira_Approval_Status
agents.description: Reads the Jira ticket status and changelog to see whether an analyst approved or rejected containment.

agents.name: Still_Pending
agents.description: Still awaiting a decision and under the 4h timeout: loop back and check again.

agents.name: Approval_Timed_Out
agents.description: No decision within 4 hours: stop and record the timeout in Jira. No containment is taken.

payload.body: Containment approval TIMED OUT (no decision within 4 hours). No automated action taken. Manual review required.

agents.name: Build_Dedup_Key
agents.description: Builds a stable dedup key (alert + user + host). Stored as a Jira label on new tickets.

agents.name: Search_Open_Duplicate
agents.description: Looks for an open SOC ticket with the same dedup label created in the last 24h.

payload.jql: project = SOC AND labels = "<<build_dedup_key.dedup_key>>" AND statusCategory != Done AND created >= -24h ORDER BY created DESC

agents.name: Comment_On_Existing_Ticket
agents.description: Adds a repeat-detection comment to the existing ticket. No new ticket, no re-containment.

payload.body: *Repeat detection* - <<webhook.body.result.alert_name>> for <<webhook.body.result.user>> on <<webhook.body.result.host>> at <<webhook.body.result.event_time>> (src_ip: <<webhook.body.result.src_ip>>). Grouped into this open incident; no new ticket or containment triggered.

agents.name: Wazuh_Auth_OK
agents.description: Only lets containment run if Wazuh login returned 200 and a token.

payload.body: *Containment NOT executed* - Wazuh API login failed (HTTP <<wazuh_auth.status>>). Planned action: <<set_containment_type.containment_type>>. Check the Wazuh tunnel/credential and contain manually.

agents.name: Lookup_Wazuh_Agent
agents.description: Finds the Wazuh agent ID for the alert's host so isolation targets the right machine.

payload.body: *Host isolation NOT executed* - no Wazuh agent found with name "<<webhook.body.result.host>>". Isolate manually.

diagram_notes.content:
## Containment routing (fixed: #4)
- **One lookup table** in `Set_Containment_Type` (`LOCAL.containment_table`) maps `alert_name → containment_type`.
- **One gate** (`Should_Contain`), then exactly one containment path.
- **Add a new attack type:** add one row to the table.

## Human approval in Jira (fixed: #6)
- `block_ip` runs automatically.
- For `disable_user` and `isolate_host`, Tines comments on the ticket and then **checks the Jira status every 60s**:
  - **Containment Approved** → logs the approver's name, then Wazuh containment runs
  - **Containment Rejected** → logs it; no action
  - **No decision within 4h** → timeout comment; no action
- Who can approve is controlled by Jira's transition permissions. The Jira history is the audit trail.
- **Required in Jira:** add the statuses `Containment Approved` and `Containment Rejected` (exact names) to the SOC workflow.

## Known gap: src_ip = "N/A" (#7)
DCSync, Encoded PowerShell, Scheduled Task, Rogue Admin and PsExec have **no network source**. IP enrichment and IP-based allowlisting don't apply to them. `Set_Containment_Type.src_ip_available` flags this. **Recommended fix:** in Splunk, correlate with 4624 logon source IP or Sysmon EID 3.
